title: Why Do Flamingos Stand on One Leg? 🦩 #Shorts
description:
Flamingos stand on one leg to save body heat — water pulls warmth out of their long legs fast, so tucking one leg against the body keeps them warm. Scientists found flamingos stand on one leg more in cold water, and they can even sleep this way with half their brain awake.
